claimReward().details: updateReward flushes earned() into s_rewards[msg.sender] before this         function body executes, so `reward` always reflects the fully up-to-date value.

constructor.details: The deployer (expected to be a StakingFactory or a multisig) becomes         the owner via Ownable(msg.sender).         Both token addresses are validated — zero addresses are rejected immediately         to prevent silent misconfiguration.

params._rewardToken: T11 ERC20 token that will be distributed as rewards.
params._stakeToken: ERC20 token that users will deposit into the pool.

earned(address).details: Combines two sources:         1) Newly accumulated rewards since the user's last checkpoint:            balance * (rewardPerToken_NOW - userRewardPerTokenPaid) / 1e18            The subtraction ensures the user only earns rewards from the moment            they entered the pool, not from the beginning of the pool's existence.         Example:           balance = 100, rewardPerToken = 8e18, checkpoint = 6e18, stored = 50           earned = 100 * (8e18 - 6e18) / 1e18 + 50 = 200 + 50 = 250 T11

params.account: Address of the staker to query.

returns._0: Total T11 rewards earned and pending claim.

emergencyWithdraw().details: Intentionally skips both the nonReentrant modifier and updateReward.         - s_rewards[msg.sender] is zeroed, permanently losing any accrued but           unclaimed T11 (including rewards not yet flushed by updateReward).         - State changes precede the external transfer, so reentrancy is not a concern           despite the missing modifier.         Use ONLY in emergency situations where normal withdraw() is unavailable         (e.g. a bug in the reward accounting logic causing reverts).

emergencyWithdrawAll().details: Intended exclusively for critical exploit response or contract migration.         Calling this function will render all user withdrawals impossible —         stakers will be unable to recover their deposits until the contract is replaced.         Both token balances are transferred in a single call to minimise the         window between checks and transfers during an exploit scenario.

exit().details: Delegates to withdraw(s_balances[msg.sender]) followed by claimReward().         Reentrancy protection and the reward snapshot are handled inside each         delegated function — no additional guards are needed here.         This is the recommended way to fully exit the pool in a single transaction.

lastTimeRewardApplicable().details: Caps block.timestamp at s_periodFinish.         This prevents the reward accumulator from growing beyond the funded window —         once the period ends, no additional T11 accrues regardless of elapsed time.

returns._0: The lesser of block.timestamp and s_periodFinish.

notifyRewardAmount(uint256,uint256).details: updateReward(address(0)) MUST run before rewardRate is mutated.         Without this snapshot, any T11 earned between the last user interaction and         now would be silently lost when the rate changes.         Approval requirement: the owner must approve this contract for at least         `reward` T11 before calling — tokens are pulled via safeTransferFrom.

params.duration: Length of the reward period in seconds.
params.reward: Total amount of T11 tokens to distribute over the period.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

rewardPerToken().details: This is the core of the Synthetix reward distribution pattern.         The value is a monotonically increasing accumulator scaled by 1e18.         Returns s_rewardPerTokenStored unchanged when totalSupply == 0         to avoid division by zero (no stakers → no reward distribution).         Example:           rewardRate = 10 T11/s, totalSupply = 100 tokens, timeDelta = 60 s           rewardPerToken += (60 * 10 * 1e18) / 100 = 6e18           → every staked token has earned 6 T11 over those 60 seconds.

returns._0: Current reward-per-token accumulator value, scaled by 1e18.

stake(uint256).details: updateReward snapshots the caller's rewards BEFORE incrementing the balance.         This is critical — without the snapshot, the new deposit would retroactively         earn rewards from before the user entered, inflating their T11 payout.

params.amount: Amount of stake tokens to deposit. Must be greater than zero.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdraw(uint256).details: updateReward snapshots the caller's rewards BEFORE decrementing the balance.         This preserves pending T11 on partial withdrawals — without the snapshot,         the balance reduction would reduce the user's calculated earnings retroactively.

params.amount: Amount of stake tokens to withdraw.

claimReward().notice: Claims all pending T11 rewards for the caller.

constructor.notice: Deploys a new StakingPool for a given stake/reward token pair.

earned(address).notice: Returns the total T11 rewards earned but not yet claimed by `account`.

emergencyWithdraw().notice: Withdraws the caller's entire stake immediately, forfeiting ALL pending T11 rewards.

emergencyWithdrawAll().notice: Drains the entire balance of both the stake token and T11 to the owner address.

exit().notice: Withdraws the caller's entire stake and claims all pending T11 rewards atomically.

lastTimeRewardApplicable().notice: Returns the timestamp up to which rewards are currently being distributed.

notifyRewardAmount(uint256,uint256).notice: Funds the pool with T11 rewards and sets the emission rate for a new period.

rewardPerToken().notice: Calculates the cumulative T11 reward per staked token up to the current moment.

s_lastUpdateTime().notice: Timestamp of the last time the global accumulator was updated.

s_periodFinish().notice: Timestamp at which the current reward period ends.

s_rewardPerTokenStored().notice: Global accumulator — total T11 earned per staked token since inception, scaled by 1e18.

s_rewardPool().notice: Cumulative amount of T11 deposited via notifyRewardAmount() since deployment.

s_rewardRate().notice: T11 tokens emitted per second, distributed proportionally across all stakers.

s_rewards(address).notice: Snapshotted unclaimed T11 rewards per user.

s_totalSupply().notice: Sum of all currently staked token balances across all users.

s_userRewardPerTokenPaid(address).notice: Per-user snapshot of rewardPerTokenStored at the time of their last interaction.

stake(uint256).notice: Stakes `amount` of the stake token into the pool.

withdraw(uint256).notice: Withdraws `amount` of stake tokens from the pool.
